name: ignition-toolbox
description: Ignition Automation Toolkit - Visual acceptance testing platform for Ignition SCADA
author: Nigel G

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run watch:electron" "wait-on tcp:3000 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:backend && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:backend:win && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:win: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
